subject: version-controlled github wikis -- how to link images?

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: version-controlled github wikis -- how to link images?
parts:
Hi,

I believe github has changed something about their wiki pages, and I can't get my new pages to show images. Has anyone faced the same issue and found a solution?

Here's a home page 
https://github.com/baptiste/gtable/wiki
the markdown is generated from a Rmd file where I set opts_chunk$set(fig.path='images/')

the actual image files appear to be moved to 
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/baptiste/gtable/images/plot1.png

something that knitr and I didn't really expect. I'm using Rstudio with its default rmarkdown settings.

Thanks,

baptiste

messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] version-controlled github wikis -- how to link images?
parts:
Hi babtiste,

You can probably fix this by setting the base url appropriately, something like (haven't tested, but I think):  

    opts_knit$set(base.url = https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/baptiste/gtable/), fig.path="images/")

Another work-around would be to use something like opts_knit$set(upload.fun = imgur.upload) to host the files externally (using absolute URLs so they should work anywhere).

Cheers,

Carl

messages.author: c8aa60c9df49a226
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: version-controlled github wikis -- how to link images?
parts:
I use a variant of a makefile that first knits all the .Rmd files and then uses sed (homebrew gsed on mac) to change all the syntax highlighting to coffeescript, which looks pretty decent for R code.



%.md: %.Rmd


	# knit the file to create a markdown file
	Rscript -e 'knitr::knit("$*.Rmd")'



	# change the syntax highlighting to coffee instead of r


	gsed -i 's/```r/```coffee/g' $*.md
